tagline: Self-hosted anime and manga media server with Intel hardware transcoding
description:
Seanime is an open-source media server with a web interface and desktop
app for anime and manga. It integrates with AniList, manages your local
library, streams and downloads episodes, and plays them with your media
player of choice.

This package uses the hwaccel image (umagistr/seanime:*-hwaccel). It
runs as a non-root user and ships Jellyfin-FFmpeg with Intel QSV and
VAAPI drivers, and passes /dev/dri through for hardware transcoding.
It needs an Intel GPU on an amd64 host and uses host port 3213 so it
can run next to the other Seanime variants.
author: restuindrawan

tips.before_install:
Intel QSV/VAAPI: this variant needs an Intel GPU and /dev/dri on
the Zima box. The image's maintainer notes hardware features could
not be tested in CI, so check them on your own hardware. Without
a working GPU, transcoding falls back to software or fails.

Set VIDEO_GID and RENDER_GID to the numeric group IDs that own the
GPU devices. On the Zima box run `ls -ln /dev/dri` and use the
group column for card0 (VIDEO_GID) and renderD128 (RENDER_GID).
Wrong values mean no GPU access inside the container.

Rootless image: Seanime runs as UID:GID 1000:1000. The config,
anime and downloads folders must be readable and writable by that
user.

This app has its own config folder and WebUI port (3213), so it
does not share settings with the other Seanime variants. Do not run
two variants against the same downloads folder at the same time.

Publishing outside your LAN: set a server password first. Seanime's
docs require server.password when the server is reachable from
outside this machine. Set SEANIME_SERVER_PASSWORD during install,
or edit config.toml in the config folder after the first start and
set password under [server], then restart. A password is not
encryption: prefer a VPN such as Tailscale or an HTTPS reverse
proxy over forwarding plain HTTP port 3213 on your router.

title: Seanime HwAccel
release_note: Add the Intel hardware acceleration Seanime variant, pinned to v3.10.4, on host port 3213 with /dev/dri passthrough, VIDEO_GID/RENDER_GID and optional SEANIME_SERVER_PASSWORD.
